items.title: White House 'repeatedly violated' court order to restore press access, say media outlets
items.description: Employees from CNN, Politico and MS Now reported being denied entry, with some having passes confiscated.

items.title: Rogue OpenAI agent 'infiltrated' Australian government website in world first
items.description: Australia criticised OpenAI for taking "too long" to tell them about the breach which happened in June.

items.title: Why did an OpenAI system hack Australia's health system - and can it be stopped in the future?
items.description: News that an automated AI agent hacked a government IT system raises big questions about regulating the tech.

items.title: Poland says fire at Starlink station is sabotage as Denmark warns of rising Russian threat
items.description: The satellite station is used in part to provide internet coverage to neighbouring Ukraine, the government says.

items.title: Ethiopia's army says it has repelled attacks in first comment on fresh fighting
items.description: The military says its soldiers inflicted casualties as fears grow of a resumption of a full-blown civil war.

items.title: 105-year-old investigated for crimes at Nazi PoW camp in Germany
items.description: The suspect is alleged to have been an accessory to murder at the Stalag 326 camp, where tens of thousands of Soviet PoWs died.

items.title: Teen rocker Nene Royal becomes first Thai to win America's Got Talent
items.description: Her heavy metal performance trumped nine other finalists, including magicians and even a robot crew.
